summary.text: Octavio Hernandez is the Democratic candidate for Florida House of Representatives District 51 in the November 3, 2026 general election, and a teacher who ran for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Octavio Hernandez was born in Mexico City, Mexico, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Central Florida in 2015.
His career experience includes working as a teacher, according to Ballotpedia.
Hernandez was the Democratic nominee for Florida House District 51 in 2024, when incumbent Josie Tomkow won the general election with 56.9% of the vote to his 43.1%.

In a Ballotpedia survey he completed in 2023, he described himself as an immigrant, father, teacher and community activist, and named mental health, public education and smart growth as his key messages.
